interpretation: the representation collapsed: by step 350 the mean pairwise cosine between the native student CLS features of different images is 0.996 and between the 32 aggregated visual slots it is 1.0000
the Said ranking lost all discrimination: the positive and negative scores differ by 0.00085 and both sit at about -1.98, so every hinge saturates and loss_said is pinned at exactly the margin 0.2000

the router is dead: the selected and the excluded slots score identically (7.90625), the logit standard deviation inside a pair fell to 0.107 and sigmoid(a) is saturated at 1.000, so the straight-through proxy receives almost no mask-learning gradient
the aggregation stayed flat from the start (slot pairwise cosine 0.81 at step 1, i.e. the 32 slots were already nearly collinear before training), so the gate had little to separate

the reconstruction term is the only one still improving (cos error 1.0351 -> 0.3125) and it can minimise its loss with a nearly input-independent prediction: on the fixed 64-image cohort the prediction variance stays ~1e-4, R@1 against the frozen teacher bank stays at chance (1/64) and a constant prediction equal to the teacher mean scores 0.2923, i.e. the decoder is not better than a constant

the hard gate tie-break is by ascending slot index, so once the slots collapse the mask becomes 'the first 16 slots' and the U branch becomes content-independent
